//: Markup-fidelity fixture for the callout component. See ../README.md and button.json/card.json for the model. Callouts are documentation-style boxes with a left (inline-start) border accent — NOT dismissible, no filled background (that's the alert). Canonical shape from snippets/callouts.html + _callouts.scss: base .pa-callout + a variant modifier; optional .pa-callout__heading (an <h4>); optional floated .pa-callout__icon which, when present, forces the rest of the content into a .pa-callout__content clearfix wrapper. When there's NO icon, heading + body are direct children of .pa-callout (no __content wrapper).

propsVocabulary.heading: heading text rendered in an <h4> .pa-callout__heading
propsVocabulary.icon: glyph/markup rendered inside the floated .pa-callout__icon; its presence wraps heading+body in .pa-callout__content

goldenConventions: Structural only — callouts add no attribute conventions like button's type. Slot content is a plain text token (Body/heading/icon glyph) so the diff checks structural nesting, not rich content. The heading element is always an <h4>. When an icon is present, heading+body live inside .pa-callout__content; without an icon they are direct children of .pa-callout. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css (NOT components.json). `produces` is a class template expanded by capability.mjs and cross-checked against main.css + each wrapper map. `produces: null` = structural (no pa-callout modifier). Axis-1 reverse check is block-modifier-scoped (pa-callout--*); element modifiers (__icon/__heading/__content) are verified forward via `produces`.

icon.note: presence also forces the .pa-callout__content clearfix wrapper around heading+body

body.note: default content; wrapped in .pa-callout__content only when an icon is present

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

cssStateClasses.//: pa-callout element modifier that is verified forward via a feature's produces, not a block modifier — listed so the axis-1 reverse check (block-modifier-scoped) stays clean. __content has no block modifier so nothing is needed here, but kept for symmetry with the model.

scenarios.note: An icon floats to the start; the rest of the content is wrapped in .pa-callout__content for the clearfix (snippets/callouts.html).
